name: Bambu Lab
description: Connects to Bambu Lab printers and manages AMS spool assignments.

name: Bambuddy
description: Connects to Bambuddy for AMS inventory and filament usage.

name: FilaMan Swatch
description: Browse filament inventory and colors, compare color harmonies, and pin palettes.

name: Moonraker
description: Sends spool assignments to Klipper printers through Moonraker. Setup also requires the FilaMan component on the Moonraker host.

name: Spoolman API
description: Lets tools that speak the Spoolman API connect to FilaMan.

name: FilaBrain (Development Preview)
description: Development preview of source-backed filament and spool research in FilaMan. Connect an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint for model-assisted research and chat.

name: SpoolmanScale
description: Shows the web interface of a SpoolmanScale inside FilaMan. The scale's address comes from FilaMan's device list, so there is nothing to set up. Needs SpoolmanScale firmware 0.8.3 or newer with FilaMan as its backend.

name: Bambu Usage Tracking
description: Deducts the filament of Bambu Lab prints from the matching FilaMan spools and keeps a print history with plate previews. Needs the Bambu Lab driver plugin with the printer set up, and one restart of FilaMan after the first install. Do not combine with Bambuddy's usage tracking on the same printer.

name: Elegoo Centauri Carbon 1
description: Shows live print status, spool and CANVAS slots, and a print history with plate previews for the Elegoo Centauri Carbon 1, and books measured filament usage for single-spool prints. Needs the OpenCentauri patched firmware and LAN access to the printer on TCP port 3030. Use only one automatic usage deduction per printer.
